selftestContract: node scripts/spotcheck-adopt.mjs --selftest exits 0 and prints SPOTCHECK_ADOPT_SELFTEST: PASS (n/n) with n>=22 plus VERDICT: PASS
note: Each find must occur exactly once in the target bytes; the runner applies ONE literal replacement per sandbox copy. A NO-MATCH at M means the anchor drifted with the landed bytes, not that the arm is covered. L1 re-anchor: d/e literals follow the retire(journal)/retire(dir) hardening.

mutants.defect: journal staged after the first destination write (kill at the journal stage then lands on a dirty half-state instead of clean bytes + published journal)
kills: selftest case crash-journal (row must be false at journal-stage kill)

mutants.defect: recovery gated to --adopt instead of every non-selftest invocation
kills: selftest cases stale-tmp (--predict must recover), foreign-journal (--check must refuse), crash-journal/crash-row (--check must recover)

mutants.defect: rollback restores from a hash-only stub instead of the .pre bytes
kills: selftest cases crash-journal/crash-row (rolled-back recovery must restore byte-exact pre-images)

mutants.defect: journal not removed after a successful adopt
mutants.find:
if (!after.clean) throw new Error('oracle refused');
    retire(journal);
kills: selftest cases check-clean / idempotence (next invocation must not print RECOVERED; exact single-line output)
mutants.note: re-anchored by the L1 after the retire-by-rename hardening

kills: selftest case stale-tmp (journalNames must be empty after recovery)
mutants.note: re-anchored by the L1 after the retire-by-rename hardening

mutants.defect: foreign-lane journal accepted and processed as local (evidence destroyed)
kills: selftest case foreign-journal (must exit 2 REFUSED_JOURNAL_FOREIGN and retain bytes + journal)

mutants.defect: RECOVERED printed unconditionally (recovery line emitted with no journal present)
mutants.replace: catch (e) { if (e.code === 'ENOENT') { lines.push('RECOVERED - stale'); return; } throw e; }
kills: selftest case check-clean red-before (a clean fixture must print no RECOVERED line) — the constant-printer killer
